_comment: Single source of truth for configurable values. The GUI reads this to decide what to show the investigator; the AI implementing/maintaining the system reads it to know which knobs exist. RULE: gui=true => the user may need to adjust it regularly, so surface it. gui=false => set-once / maintainer-only; keep it OUT of the investigator's UI but the implementing AI must know it exists. 'group' organizes the GUI; 'advanced' groups can be behind a disclosure.

settings.label: Case context & instructions
settings.help: The instructions and case knowledge the review agent uses to recognize who/what is being referenced. This is the most important editable field — update it as the case develops. Sensitive content stays local when backend=claude-code.

settings.label: Review agent backend
settings.help: claude-code = your local instance (sensitive case context never leaves the machine). openrouter = test API models (use only since nothing in THIS project is confidential).

settings.label: Review agent model
settings.help: Model id. For claude-code backend, a Claude model; for openrouter, an OpenRouter model slug (e.g. qwen/qwen3-vl-8b-instruct).

settings.label: Parallel files under review
settings.help: How many media files are reviewed at once. ONE agent per file is the design (precision); raise cautiously — too many at once can dilute attention and rate-limit the API.

settings.label: Include unverified results by default
settings.help: Show AI conclusions that a human hasn't confirmed yet. Off = only verified/high-confidence.

settings.label: Speaker visual-confidence floor
settings.help: Below this, a visually-confirmed speaker is still flagged for review. Tune using the coverage report.

settings.label: Voice/face name-match floor
settings.help: How similar a voice/face must be to an enrolled person to get their name. Lower = more names + more false matches.

settings.label: New-location sensitivity
settings.help: Hamming distance (of the 64-bit scene hash) above which a shot counts as a new location.

settings.label: Storage backend
settings.help: Set once at install. sqlite for a single investigator; postgres for a shared central index.

settings.label: ASR model
settings.help: Set-once. The implementing AI manages model choice; the investigator never changes it.

settings.label: Embedding model
settings.help: Set-once. Changing it requires re-embedding and matching TEXT_EMBED_DIM + vec table dimension.

settings.label: Embedding dimension
settings.help: Set-once. Must match the embedding model and the vector(N)/vec0 schema dimension.

settings.label: Scene-cut detection threshold
settings.help: Deterministic shot detection; set-once. Distinct from LOCATION_CHANGE_THRESHOLD (which the user may tune).

settings.label: Footage folder
settings.help: Set at install. Read-only; never modified.
